title: Go and Python report application metadata
notes: Node and TypeScript already sent LaunchDarkly application metadata carrying the release; Go and Python did not, so they reported no deployed version. Closing it keeps deployed-version evidence consistent across all four languages, which matters because the talk distinguishes a flag removed from current source from one still evaluated by an older deployed tag.
Go sets ApplicationInfo on the client config; Python passes application id and version to Config. Both rebuilt and re-run against the live project in Dev before this step was written.
